# REDTEAM #175 (IMPLEMENTATION.md M19-S5, T-301.2/T-0.1): finalizer and
# cleanup attachment MUST exclude the containing span from evacuation until
# span reuse without making that exclusion a GC root; cleanup argument and
# closure references MUST remain valid when moved; concurrent moving mode
# MUST remain unavailable until attachment and relocation are synchronized
# and verified. This script runs the stop-the-world exclusion and
# upstream-semantics gates in an immix-linked test binary under the moving
# experiment. The concurrent
# prerequisite stays blocked, so the row stays planned (parent owns the
# ledger).
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosgcmoving
go test -v -ldflags=-X=runtime.logosGCMode=immix -count=1 -run 'TestLogosNoRelocFinalizerSetAndRemove|TestLogosNoRelocCleanupSetAndStop|TestLogosNoRelocClearedByInit|TestLogosFinalizerResurrectionAndReRegistration|TestLogosFinalizerThenCleanupReclaims|TestLogosCleanupStopPreventsCall' runtime
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosNoRelocFinalizerSetAndRemove'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosNoRelocCleanupSetAndStop'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosNoRelocClearedByInit'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosFinalizerResurrectionAndReRegistration'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosFinalizerThenCleanupReclaims'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosCleanupStopPreventsCall'
stdout '^ok\s+runtime'
! stderr 'no tests to run'
go test -race -v -ldflags=-X=runtime.logosGCMode=immix -count=1 -run 'TestLogosNoRelocFinalizerSetAndRemove|TestLogosNoRelocCleanupSetAndStop|TestLogosNoRelocClearedByInit|TestLogosFinalizerResurrectionAndReRegistration|TestLogosFinalizerThenCleanupReclaims|TestLogosCleanupStopPreventsCall' runtime
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosNoRelocFinalizerSetAndRemove'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosNoRelocCleanupSetAndStop'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosNoRelocClearedByInit'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosFinalizerResurrectionAndReRegistration'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosFinalizerThenCleanupReclaims'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosCleanupStopPreventsCall'
stdout '^ok\s+runtime'
! stderr 'no tests to run'
